question: Shobhita can complete a painting work in 20 hours while Saroj can complete the same work in 15 hours. In how much time (in hours) can the entire work of painting be completed, if both Shobhita and Saroj work simultaneously?
solution:
**Given:**

Shobhita can complete a painting work in 20 hours

Saroj can complete the same work in 15 hours

**Formula used:**

If A can complete the work in a hours and B can complete the same work in b hours, then working together they can complete the work in dfrac{ab}{a+b} hours

**Calculation:**

Shobhita's time (a) = 20 hours

Saroj's time (b) = 15 hours

⇒ Time taken together = dfrac{20 times 15}{20 + 15}

⇒ Time taken together = dfrac{300}{35}

⇒ Time taken together = 8dfrac{4}{7} hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
